descriptions.zh:
本接口支持删除指定的字幕规则。

><notice>当前实时字幕功能处于邀测阶段，单个用户最多可添加300个字幕模板。
></notice>

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation deletes the specified caption rules.

><notice>

The real-time caption feature is in invitational preview. Each user can add a maximum of 300 caption templates.

></notice>

## QPS limit

The queries-per-second (QPS) limit for this operation is 60 calls per second for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-ai-produce-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rules-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d_-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --suffix-name et --domain demo.aliyundoc.com --app AppName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveAIProduceRules --region cn-hangzhou --App AppName --RulesId '445409ec-7eaa-461d_-8f29-4bec2eb90000' --SuffixName et --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'demo.aliyundoc.com'
